_comment: First look at the lease scheduler (scheduler/lease.py: one slot per task, held over tool waits of up to 2 s): W1 0.95X seed 42, four 6,144-token slots, no host cache, FIFO c = 5 then lease back to back. Two runs, ~30 min. One seed shows the direction only; phase2_lease is the paired comparison. Before reading latencies, check the lease run's run_config.json: scheduler_summary.pin_mismatches should be 0 (llama-server honoured id_slot) and followups_kept should be close to the number of follow-ups. Compare with: python -m analysis.paired results/phase2_lease_quick --baseline fifo_c5
name: phase2_lease_quick
